mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, connector, endpoint, external_list_id, credential_ref, credential_last4, enabled, created_by_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM connector_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY connector
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO connector_config (workspace_id, connector, endpoint, external_list_id, credential_ref, credential_last4, enabled, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{connector}, #{endpoint}, #{externalListId}, #{credentialRef}, #{credentialLast4}, #{enabled}, #{createdById}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE endpoint = VALUES(endpoint), external_list_id = VALUES(external_list_id), credential_ref = VALUES(credential_ref), credential_last4 = VALUES(credential_last4), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM connector_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND connector = #{connector}
